understanding.goal_understanding: The objective is to complete each level by activating and stepping onto all goal cells. A goal cell only completes when the carried piece simultaneously matches the goal’s required shape, color, and rotation; once all goals in the level are completed, you advance to the next level, and completing all levels wins the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: You move on a grid using cardinal actions; each move costs 1 stamina. When stamina reaches 0 you lose 1 life and stamina resets to its maximum; losing all lives ends the game. Walls block movement, and the game provides a blocked_directions list each turn indicating moves that cannot be made from the current cell (attempting them wastes a turn/stamina and does not change position). Special modifier tiles change the piece when stepped on: shape modifiers cycle shapes 0–5 (wrapping), color modifiers cycle colors in the order orange → blue → green → red → orange, and rotation modifiers rotate 90° clockwise (0° → 90° → 180° → 270° → 0°). Some levels also include stamina refill tiles. Effective play requires planning routes to visit the needed modifiers to match goal requirements, then stepping onto the goal while matched, while avoiding blocked directions and managing stamina/lives.
